title: DOW-UAP-D098, Film Analysis of Unidentified Objects, 1953
doc_notes: This document is a progress report from the U.S. Naval Photographic Interpretation Center regarding the analysis of two films of unidentified objects from 1950 and 1952, containing extensive technical charts and densitometric data.

incidents.summary: Analysis of 16mm color motion picture film depicting unidentified objects in Utah.
incidents.quote: it appears as if the objects are of a nature which we are not able to identify in terms of natural phenomena

incidents.summary: Analysis of motion picture film depicting unidentified objects in Montana.
incidents.quote: There is no indication of what kind of objects could have caused the images
